method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: The corridor is lettered 'AVENUE M' inside the roadway I measured on both plates, and on both it is the 1200/1300 hundred-block break of the numbered streets: the block face west of it reads 1201 1203 ... 1223 / 1202 1204 ... 1224 and the face east of it reads 1301 1303 ... 1323 / 1302 1304 ... 1324, on sheet 51 and on sheet 57 alike. One block EAST is excluded because that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE M 1/2' on both plates - sheet 51 with the outlot-16 N.E./N.W. quarters between M and M 1/2, sheet 57 with the outlot-15 N.E./N.W. quarters - and it carries the 1300/1400 break (1401 1403 1405 / 1402 1404 beyond it). One block WEST is excluded because that corridor is lettered 'AVENUE L' on both plates (sheet 57 roadway native 82.6-292.9; on sheet 51 only its east face survives, at native 241.6, the plate edge cutting the rest) and it carries the 1100/1200 break. The block column between Ave L and Ave M is continuous across the shared 27TH ST seam with consecutive block numbers and hundred-block avenue addresses: sheet 51 has block 25 (avenue faces 2509-2528, 25th-26th) and block 26 (2601-2628, 26th-27th); sheet 57 continues with block 27 (2701-2729, 27th-28th) and block 28 (2801-2822, 28th-29th). Sheet 51's south margin prints '57' as its adjoining plate and sheet 57's title block reads 57, confirming the two are stacked on 27TH ST. Corroboration: drafted roadway width 211.8 native px on sheet 51 and 211.7 on sheet 57, matching the printed 70' avenue; a cross-check on Ave L's east face gives the same cross-plate shift to within 0.6 px, so these two plates show no significant scale disagreement. MEASUREMENT: midpoint of the two facing block lines, read off the green native ruler in the band immediately adjacent to the shared 27TH ST seam and averaged over the two crops that show the corridor - sheet 51 faces 1029.1/1240.9 (cand1) and 1026.6/1238.4 (cand2), sheet 57 faces 1087.0/1298.7 (cand2) and 1084.7/1296.4 (cand1). Implied cross-plate shift 57.9 px. Sheet 51's raster carries a slight rotation (about 0.2 deg), so its Ave M drifts from about 1145 at the top of the crop to 1134 at the seam; the seam-adjacent value is the one reported because that is where the two plates join. NOTE: no reported coordinate is a detection candidate - the candidates on both sheets (51: 760/1770/2781, 57: 698/1706/2715) are mid-block lines near the 20-ft alleys (sheet 51 block 26 alley native 602.6-662.9, sheet 57 block 27 alley 659.0-720.8), not avenues.
